resonant_arcana.message.hold_wand: Hold the debug wand to inspect its selected spell.
resonant_arcana.message.explosion_s_lock: Explosion's locked target is no longer reachable

resonant_arcana.tooltip.learn: Sneak-use with a matching scroll in your offhand to learn its level.
spell.resonant_arcana.spark.description: Loose a compact arcane spark along your aim. It stops at the first enemy or solid surface, releasing a small arcane impact.
spell.resonant_arcana.arcane_strike.desc: Focus arcane energy directly on one visible aimed enemy. A woven link identifies the struck target; terrain blocks targeting.
spell.resonant_arcana.blood_spark.descri: Snap a crimson spark onto one visible aimed enemy. Blood droplets mark the impact; this attack does not restore health.
spell.resonant_arcana.poison_spark.descr: Burst an acid bubble on one visible aimed enemy, dealing direct damage and applying Poison I for four seconds.
spell.resonant_arcana.blood_wave.descrip: Send a broad crimson crescent along your aim. Its moving front cuts each visible enemy once and dissipates against solid cover.
spell.resonant_arcana.poison_wave.descri: Roll a low green acid wave forwards. Each enemy crossed by its broad front takes one direct hit and Poison I for four seconds.
spell.resonant_arcana.flame_wave.descrip: Drive a broad wall of flickering embers forwards. Its advancing front hits each visible enemy once and ignites them for three seconds.
spell.resonant_arcana.confuse.descriptio: Disorient one visible enemy with Nausea for five seconds and Blindness for two seconds. Deals no direct damage.
spell.resonant_arcana.stun.description: Bind one visible aimed enemy with arcane sparks. Apply Slowness VI and Weakness II for three seconds, with one direct hit; immune enemies may resist the effects.
spell.resonant_arcana.capture.descriptio: Wind an arcane cage around one aimed enemy for three seconds at level I. Suppress movement and melee damage while the link holds. Cover, range or displacement of more than four blocks breaks it.
spell.resonant_arcana.astral_comet.descr: Launch a slow astral comet with a bright core and trailing star motes. It bursts around the first enemy or solid surface reached, damaging visible enemies in the impact area.
spell.resonant_arcana.fire_comet.descrip: Hurl a slow ember comet with a burning wake. Its first collision releases an area detonation and ignites enemies hit for three seconds.
spell.resonant_arcana.arcane_repulse.des: Release an expanding arcane pressure ring from your feet. Enemies touched by the advancing rim take one hit and are pushed away; walls block the hit.
spell.resonant_arcana.fireball.descripti: Throw a compact fireball with a coiling ember trail. Its first collision releases a small area burst and ignites enemies hit for three seconds.
spell.resonant_arcana.ignite.description: Kindle one visible aimed enemy directly. Deal the listed impact damage and set it burning for three seconds; ordinary fire immunity still applies.
spell.resonant_arcana.launch.description: Send a rising arcane strike into one visible aimed enemy, adding upward velocity. This lifts the target; it does not grant the enemy fall protection.
spell.resonant_arcana.leap.description: Vault forwards and upwards in an arcane wake. This is a movement spell with no direct damage; choose a safe landing.
spell.resonant_arcana.lightning.descript: Call a vertical lightning strike onto your aim. Enemies near the strike take one hit; the spell leaves terrain intact.
spell.resonant_arcana.smite.description: Mark your aim with holy light, then deliver a vertical judgement strike. Visible enemies within its impact radius take the listed damage; allies are protected.
spell.resonant_arcana.fire_twister.descr: Raise a stationary ember funnel at your aim for two seconds. Four half-second pulses can damage visible enemies inside and refresh three seconds of burning.
spell.resonant_arcana.flame_thrower.desc: Channel a narrow flame stream along your aim for three seconds. Six pulses damage enemies and ignite them for three seconds. Solid cover stops the stream.
spell.resonant_arcana.flame_shock_wave.d: Send an expanding ember ring across the ground around you. Its advancing rim damages each visible enemy once, pushes them away and ignites them for three seconds.
spell.resonant_arcana.blood_explode.desc: Detonate a crimson bloom at the aimed enemy or reachable aim point. Its radial blood spray damages visible enemies in the impact area once.
spell.resonant_arcana.blood_stun.descrip: Close a crimson binding around one visible aimed enemy. One hit applies Slowness VI and Weakness II for three seconds; this spell does not drain health.
spell.resonant_arcana.blood_block.descri: Deflect incoming hostile projectiles for 4 seconds at level I. Higher spell power extends the duration, up to 8 seconds.
spell.resonant_arcana.shadow_bolt.descri: Launch a twisting shadow bolt. Its first collision releases a small void impact, applying Weakness I for three seconds to enemies hit.
spell.resonant_arcana.soul_seeker.descri: Release a dark wisp that steers toward the enemy selected at release. Its impact damages and weakens enemies; solid cover intercepts the projectile.
spell.resonant_arcana.dark_wave.descript: Advance a broad curtain of shadow along your aim. Each enemy touched by the moving front takes one hit and Weakness I for three seconds.
spell.resonant_arcana.nightfall.descript: Collapse a cloud of shadow at your aim. Visible enemies in the burst take one hit, Weakness I for three seconds and brief Darkness.
spell.resonant_arcana.shadow_cage.descri: Fasten an orbiting shadow curse to one aimed enemy. After two seconds it bursts around that enemy, damaging and weakening nearby enemies. Losing line of sight or exceeding the link range breaks the curse.
spell.resonant_arcana.soul_aura.descript: Carry a dark soul aura with you for three seconds. Three one-second pulses damage visible nearby enemies and apply Weakness I for three seconds.
spell.resonant_arcana.thunder_bolt.descr: Fire a compact electric bolt with a jagged spark wake. The first enemy or solid surface stops it and releases a small electric impact.
spell.resonant_arcana.chain_lightning.de: Connect up to five distinct visible enemies with jagged lightning links. Each jump chooses a nearby eligible enemy; cover and the jump radius can end the chain early.
spell.resonant_arcana.thunder_wave.descr: Send a broad, crackling electric front forwards. Each enemy crossed by its moving rim takes one hit.
spell.resonant_arcana.storm_call.descrip: Establish a lightning storm at your aim for 4.8 seconds. Five one-second pulses damage visible enemies; additional lightning columns show the active storm area.
spell.resonant_arcana.thunder_pulse.desc: Unleash an expanding electric ring from your feet. The moving rim damages and pushes each visible enemy once, with sparks tracing its current reach.
spell.resonant_arcana.static_shock.descr: Overload one visible enemy with static. Deal one hit and apply Slowness VI and Weakness II for three seconds.
spell.resonant_arcana.gravity_bolt.descr: Send a compressed spatial orb along your aim, trailed by inward-curling portal motes. Its first collision releases a small force impact.
spell.resonant_arcana.gravity_well.descr: Open a stationary gravity well for 4.8 seconds. Pull visible enemies horizontally toward its centre and deal five one-second area pulses; walls block damage and pulling.
spell.resonant_arcana.force_push.descrip: Strike one visible aimed enemy with an outward spatial impulse. Deal direct damage and launch it away from the caster with a small upward lift.
spell.resonant_arcana.force_pull.descrip: Catch one visible aimed enemy with a spatial link. Deal direct damage and pull it horizontally toward you with a small upward lift.
spell.resonant_arcana.gravity_choke.desc: Suspend one visible aimed enemy above its starting point for two seconds. Deal one hit, slow it and briefly grant Slow Falling. Cover, range or displacement beyond four blocks breaks the hold.
spell.resonant_arcana.singularity.descri: Collapse a concentrated spatial orb at your aim. One radial force burst damages and pushes visible enemies; this instant spell leaves no lingering gravity well.
spell.resonant_arcana.echo_bolt.descript: Fire a resonant soul bolt with blue sculk motes. It ends at the first enemy or solid surface, releasing a small echo impact.
spell.resonant_arcana.sculk_wave.descrip: Roll a broad sculk resonance front forwards. Each visible enemy crossed by the advancing wave takes one hit.
spell.resonant_arcana.sonic_scream.descr: Charge for one second, then unleash a deafening, wide sonic scream over 12 blocks. Cover blocks the blast.
spell.resonant_arcana.soul_siphon.descri: Damage a visible aimed target and restore 40% of health actually removed, capped at 2 health at level I. Healing scales with spell power.
spell.resonant_arcana.soul_prison.descri: Imprison one aimed enemy in a winding soul cage for three seconds at level I. Three one-second hits apply Darkness while the hold suppresses movement. Cover, range or displacement breaks the link.
spell.resonant_arcana.shrieking_pulse.de: Release a radial sculk shriek. An expanding soul ring damages and pushes each visible enemy once as its rim passes them.
spell.resonant_arcana.amethyst_nova.desc: Shatter a resonant amethyst bloom at your aim. Crystal motes radiate from one area burst, damaging and pushing visible enemies in range.
spell.resonant_arcana.echo_ward.descript: Deflect incoming hostile projectiles for 4 seconds at level I. Higher spell power extends the duration, up to 8 seconds.
spell.resonant_arcana.arcane_volley.desc: Fire three arcane bolts half a second apart. Each bolt follows your aim when released and bursts on the first enemy or solid surface.
spell.resonant_arcana.sanguine_drain.des: Damage a visible aimed target and restore 40% of health actually removed, capped at 2 health at level I. Healing scales with spell power.
spell.resonant_arcana.blood_lance.descri: Drive a straight crimson lance through visible enemies along your aim. Each enemy on the piercing line is hit once; solid cover ends the lance.
spell.resonant_arcana.ember_veil.descrip: Carry a low ring of embers for three seconds. Three one-second pulses damage visible nearby enemies and ignite them for three seconds.
spell.resonant_arcana.venom_bolt.descrip: Spit a travelling acid orb with a spore-speckled wake. Its first collision releases a small impact that damages enemies and applies Poison I for four seconds.
spell.resonant_arcana.miasma_field.descr: Leave a low poisonous cloud at your aim for 4.8 seconds. Five one-second pulses damage visible enemies inside and refresh Poison I for four seconds.
spell.resonant_arcana.withering_hex.desc: Hex one visible enemy with direct damage, Poison I for four seconds and Wither I for three seconds.
spell.resonant_arcana.soul_cannon.descri: Charge an echo cannon for two seconds, then launch a travelling soul blast. It bursts against the first enemy or solid surface.
spell.resonant_arcana.solar_cataclysm.de: Charge for three seconds, mark your aim, then drop a blazing meteor. Ceilings limit its drop. Fire hits ignite for three seconds.
spell.resonant_arcana.tempest_spear.desc: Charge for 2.5 seconds, then fire a piercing storm lance. Solid cover stops the beam.
spell.resonant_arcana.event_horizon.desc: Charge for 3.2 seconds, then pull visible enemies inward for 1.5 seconds before a crushing detonation.
spell.resonant_arcana.doom.description: Open an elevated black hole that draws visible enemies inward, then collapses for one heavy area hit. Allies and terrain are protected.
spell.resonant_arcana.doom.sequence: One damage hit per enemy per cast.
spell.resonant_arcana.sanctuary.descript: Restore up to 12 health to yourself and eligible allies within eight blocks; cleanse poison, wither, blindness and darkness. Allies include owned pets, scoreboard teammates, and teamless players when enabled.
spell.resonant_arcana.glacial_rupture.de: Send a broad glacial front forwards, damaging and chilling each visible enemy once.
spell.resonant_arcana.evokers_edict.desc: Send three staggered rows of spectral fangs along your aim. Each enemy takes one full hit.
spell.resonant_arcana.arcane_step.descri: Blink along your aim to a clear, loaded position. Range grows by 1 block per additional spell level, up to 12 blocks.
spell.resonant_arcana.blood_needles.desc: Release five divergent blood needles. Damage is per projectile; projectiles stop at solid cover.
spell.resonant_arcana.blood_reap.descrip: Sweep a crimson crescent across a 120-degree forward arc. Each visible enemy is hit once.
spell.resonant_arcana.crimson_tether.des: Tether an aimed enemy for 3 seconds, gently pulling it and dealing three damage pulses. Cover or moving out of range breaks the link.
spell.resonant_arcana.sanguine_pact.desc: Spend 2 health to gain 4 absorption health and Strength I for 6 seconds at level I. Requires more than 2 current health. Absorption and duration grow with spell power.
spell.resonant_arcana.crimson_harvest.de: Strike an aimed enemy. Deal 50% more direct damage below 35% maximum health; a killing hit restores up to 2 health at level I.
spell.resonant_arcana.cinder_step.descri: Blink through a safe line of sight in a burst of embers. Range grows by 1 block per additional spell level.
spell.resonant_arcana.phoenix_rush.descr: Launch forwards in a rising rush and hit nearby enemies in a four-block launch burst. Slow Falling protects the short descent. Fire hits ignite for three seconds.
spell.resonant_arcana.dragon_breath.desc: Exhale a broad cone of flame following your aim for 1.5 seconds. Three pulses can hit enemies that remain in the cone. Fire hits ignite for three seconds.
spell.resonant_arcana.umbral_step.descri: Blink to a clear position and become invisible for one second. Higher levels extend blink range.
spell.resonant_arcana.dusk_cleave.descri: Carve a shadow crescent across the space in front of you, weakening enemies hit by the arc.
spell.resonant_arcana.dread_effigy.descr: Place a blackstone effigy on visible ground for four seconds. Four pulses damage nearby enemies and refresh Weakness II for 1.5 seconds.
spell.resonant_arcana.veil_of_night.desc: Gain invisibility and Speed I for six seconds at level I. Spell power extends the duration, up to twelve seconds.
spell.resonant_arcana.night_bloom.descri: Place a shadow trap. After a half-second arming period, an enemy within two blocks triggers one area explosion. Untriggered traps expire after four seconds.
spell.resonant_arcana.storm_step.descrip: Surge forwards and upwards with lightning afterimages. Slow Falling protects the short descent.
spell.resonant_arcana.thunderclap.descri: Release a broad thunder crescent and knock visible enemies away. Each target is hit once.
spell.resonant_arcana.arc_ricochet.descr: Throw a travelling lightning orb that can ricochet between three visible enemies, hitting each once.
spell.resonant_arcana.rift_blink.descrip: Blink along a clear path without crossing solid cover or loading terrain. Higher levels increase its range.
spell.resonant_arcana.orbital_blades.des: Orbit three spatial blades around yourself for three seconds. Enemies can take one hit per second, up to three hits.
spell.resonant_arcana.prismatic_ruin.des: Merge opposing energies into a slow, broad spatial orb. It passes through enemies, hitting each once, and stops at solid cover or maximum range.
spell.resonant_arcana.gravity_stamp.desc: Mark your aim for one second, then crush visible enemies with a vertical spatial impact.
spell.resonant_arcana.spatial_shear.desc: Cut a wide crescent through nearby space, striking each visible enemy in front of you once.
spell.resonant_arcana.wisp_lantern.descr: Place a soul lantern on a deepslate post for four seconds. Four echo pulses damage visible enemies near it. Each pulse reveals enemies with a glowing outline for 1.5 seconds. Requires visible solid ground; the boundary ring shows its pulse radius.
spell.resonant_arcana.resonant_guard.des: Gain 6 absorption health and Resistance I for five seconds at level I. Spell power improves absorption and duration.
spell.resonant_arcana.memory_fracture.de: Strike an aimed enemy. If it is affected by Darkness, direct damage increases by 50%; combine with Soul Prison.
spell.resonant_arcana.thorn_lash.descrip: Catch an aimed enemy with a thorn tether, pull it towards you and poison it.
spell.resonant_arcana.viper_fangs.descri: Release five venom fangs in a spreading fan. Each projectile can poison the enemy it hits.
spell.resonant_arcana.bramble_ring.descr: Expand a ring of thorns around yourself. Each visible enemy is damaged once, poisoned and briefly slowed.
spell.resonant_arcana.toxic_molt.descrip: Shed poison and wither, restore 4 health at level I and gain Speed I for four seconds. Healing and duration scale with spell power.
spell.resonant_arcana.spore_totem.descri: Plant a mushroom totem on visible ground for four seconds. Four pulses damage nearby enemies and refresh Poison I for four seconds.
spell.resonant_arcana.corrosive_rain.des: Call an acid cloud at your aim. Five falling pulses damage and poison visible enemies over four seconds.
spell.resonant_arcana.gorgon_gaze.descri: Fix visible enemies in a wide forward cone with a petrifying gaze, applying heavy slowness and weakness for two seconds at level I.
spell.resonant_arcana.luminous_dart.desc: Fire a quick dart of holy light. It stops at solid cover.
spell.resonant_arcana.mending_light.desc: Restore 6 health at level I to the most injured eligible ally within eight blocks, including yourself. Requires line of sight.
Gain 4 absorption health and Speed I for six seconds at level I. Spell power increases the shield and duration.
spell.resonant_arcana.consecration.descr: Place a radiant altar on visible ground for four seconds. Four pulses damage enemies and heal eligible allies in the marked area.
spell.resonant_arcana.radiant_sweep.desc: Sweep a radiant crescent through visible enemies in front of you.
spell.resonant_arcana.pilgrim_step.descr: Move along your aim in a flash of light, stopping before obstacles. Higher levels extend the safe blink range.
spell.resonant_arcana.absolution.descrip: Cleanse poison, wither, blindness and darkness from eligible allies within eight blocks and grant brief Resistance I.
spell.resonant_arcana.dawn_ward.descript: Deflect hostile incoming projectiles for four seconds at level I. Spell power extends the ward, up to eight seconds.
spell.resonant_arcana.judgement_ray.desc: Charge a piercing ray of holy light, striking each visible enemy on its line once. Solid cover stops the ray.
spell.resonant_arcana.seraphic_descent.d: Mark your aim for one second, then deliver a pillar of light. It damages enemies and restores 6 health at level I to eligible allies at the impact.
spell.resonant_arcana.renewal_hymn.descr: Carry a healing hymn around yourself for four seconds. Four pulses each restore 2 health at level I to eligible allies with line of sight.
spell.resonant_arcana.frost_needle.descr: Fire a fast ice needle that chills its target and stops at solid cover.
spell.resonant_arcana.ice_serpent.descri: Send a low, weaving ice serpent horizontally along your aim. It chills each enemy struck and stops at solid cover; it does not climb terrain.
spell.resonant_arcana.rime_nova.descript: Expand a frozen ring around yourself, chilling and damaging each visible enemy once.
spell.resonant_arcana.cryo_lance.descrip: Fire a precise piercing ice lance through visible enemies. Solid cover blocks it.
spell.resonant_arcana.frozen_aegis.descr: Gain 6 absorption health and Resistance I for five seconds at level I. Spell power strengthens and extends the aegis.
spell.resonant_arcana.glacier_step.descr: Blink safely in a burst of snowflakes. Higher levels increase the range without allowing travel through walls.
spell.resonant_arcana.shatter.descriptio: Strike one aimed enemy for 50% more direct damage while it is deeply frozen or affected by Slowness III or stronger. Combine with Glacial Prison or Absolute Zero.
spell.resonant_arcana.hailstorm.descript: Call a hail cloud at your aim. Five pulses damage and chill visible enemies over four seconds.
spell.resonant_arcana.glacial_prison.des: Hold an aimed enemy in spectral ice for three seconds at level I. Cover, distance or large movement breaks the restraint.
spell.resonant_arcana.crystal_barrage.de: Release five divergent crystal projectiles. Damage is per projectile; their impacts chill enemies.
spell.resonant_arcana.absolute_zero.desc: Establish a frozen domain for four seconds. Four pulses chill and freeze visible enemies in its area.
spell.resonant_arcana.warscream.descript: Release three ground-shaking roars that damage, pull and taunt nearby enemies. You and eligible allies gain Resistance I for 3–7 seconds, depending on rank.
spell.resonant_arcana.soulblast.descript: Blast a forward cone of enemies away. Aim sharply downward to launch yourself with brief Slow Falling. While gliding, boost your Elytra along your aim instead.
spell.resonant_arcana.arcane_edge.descri: Empower yourself with flat melee attack damage and faster attacks for 8–16 seconds. Refreshes the existing enchantment.
spell.resonant_arcana.bulwark_chant.desc: Grant visible nearby allies Resistance I and temporary health for 8–16 seconds. Shields refresh rather than stack.
spell.resonant_arcana.battle_tempo.descr: A rallying rhythm grants visible nearby allies faster attacks and movement for 8–16 seconds.
spell.resonant_arcana.cinder_cleave.desc: Sweep a burning crescent through a 120-degree cone. Damage includes half your melee attack attribute at release; ignites enemies.
spell.resonant_arcana.rime_thrust.descri: Drive a piercing frost thrust through enemies in a narrow line, stopping at walls. Damage includes half your melee attack attribute; heavily slows for 2 seconds.
spell.resonant_arcana.blood_rend.descrip: Rend a 90-degree crescent. Damage includes half your melee attack attribute. Restore 40% of health actually removed, capped at 3–6 health for the entire cast.
spell.resonant_arcana.krakens_grasp.desc: The full Kraken rises from beneath the marked ground, curls its tentacles and slams nearby enemies. The slam deals damage and applies three seconds of Slowness. It then sinks away.
spell.resonant_arcana.ice_spike_eruption: Five ice spikes erupt in a line across a visible ground location. Each enemy can take one hit per cast. Slows and chills enemies without freezing allies.
spell.resonant_arcana.helvars_rift.descr: Launch Helvar’s rift projectile. It stops at the first enemy or solid surface, dealing damage and applying brief Weakness.
spell.resonant_arcana.krakens_wrath.desc: Four Kraken tentacles strike around the marked ground before a central, triple-damage slam. Each enemy can take one outer hit and one central hit.
spell.resonant_arcana.krakens_wrath.sequ: One outer hit and one central hit ×3 per enemy.
spell.resonant_arcana.krakens_undertow.d: A Kraken tentacle rises at a visible ground location. Its undertow pulls nearby enemies toward the water before one heavy slam. Uses the Kraken’s red model and texture; allies and bosses are not pulled.
spell.resonant_arcana.yetis_glacial_wall: Raise seven lingering ice spikes in a crescent across visible ground. Each enemy takes at most one hit and is slowed and chilled. Terrain remains intact.
spell.resonant_arcana.helvars_fracture.d: Helvar’s rift projectile breaks against the first enemy or wall, releasing an area burst that weakens visible enemies. Terrain remains intact.
Summon Helvar’s colossal sword above the mark and drive it into the ground. The blade deals full damage within 3.5 blocks; an expanding nine-block shockwave hits other enemies for 40% damage. Each enemy takes one hit. Requires overhead space.
Blade ×1 within 3.5 blocks; outer wave ×0.4. One hit each.
spell.resonant_arcana.sandworms_eruption: The Sandworm’s own sand columns emerge in a row toward the aimed ground. The rising columns strike enemies once per cast; terrain stays intact.
spell.resonant_arcana.sandworms_quicksan: A spiralling sand vortex slows and draws visible enemies inward. Three sand columns then erupt around its rim for one final strike. Bosses and allies are never pulled; no terrain is changed.
spell.resonant_arcana.dragons_guard.desc: Conjure three blazing orbs, then launch them in sequence toward the marked ground. Each orb explodes against the first enemy or solid surface.
spell.resonant_arcana.dragons_pyre.descr: Mark visible ground with an ember ring. After a one-second warning, a descending fireball releases one heavy shockwave. Requires clear space overhead.
spell.resonant_arcana.glacial_counter.de: Guard for 0.9 seconds against one frontal, blockable hostile hit. The first 0.3 seconds block fully and return a 175% frost counter; later guards reduce damage by 70% and return a normal counter. Environmental damage and bypassing attacks are not blocked.
spell.resonant_arcana.rift_draw.descript: Draw a thin distortion along your aim. After a 0.6-second warning, a piercing slash hits visible enemies, adding half your melee attack damage. Walls stop the cut.
spell.resonant_arcana.crimson_reversal.d: Blink forward with a blood slash along the clear path, adding half your melee attack damage. Recast within three seconds to return safely to your starting position for no extra mana. The normal cooldown begins when the return is used or expires.
spell.resonant_arcana.thunderbrand.descr: Enchant your weapon for ten seconds. Every third successful player melee hit releases chain lightning to that enemy and up to two nearby enemies. Spell damage cannot build charges; recasting refreshes the enchantment without stacking it.
spell.resonant_arcana.last_stand.descrip: Plant a temporary golden banner for six seconds, surrounded by a radiant ward circle. Nearby allies gain Resistance I and one grant of temporary health. The final pulse heals allies still defending the area. Re-entering does not refill the shield.
spell.resonant_arcana.ashen_rebirth.desc: Burst forward along a clear path as a phoenix, leaving a burning silhouette. After 0.8 seconds the silhouette detonates. Grants brief Slow Falling; the movement itself deals no damage.
Summon four to eight spectral swords for ten seconds. Each successful player melee hit sends one sword toward the struck enemy. Swords have an arming flight, collide with walls and do not trigger further swords or Thunderbrand.
spell.resonant_arcana.funeral_bell.descr: Charge a funeral bell. Two expanding sonic rings deal the listed damage; a third toll deals triple damage. Each ring strikes an enemy at most once, briefly slowing and pushing it. Walls block the waves.
spell.resonant_arcana.spellbreaker.descr: Sweep a close cone, adding half your melee attack damage. Destroy up to 32 hostile or unowned projectiles and interrupt eligible Iron’s casts. Allies, owned projectiles, protected casts and unrelated magic systems are not cancelled.
Call three groups of falling stars around the mark. Each star damages enemies within four blocks of its impact. A final arcane collapse deals double damage across fourteen blocks.
Nine local star impacts; final area hit ×2.
spell.resonant_arcana.crimson_eclipse.de: Release three blood tides around the mark, followed by a double-damage final tide. Heal for 8% of health actually removed, up to twenty health across the whole cast.
spell.resonant_arcana.world_pyre.descrip: Call five meteors around the mark. Each erupts in a five-block blast. A final fourteen-block firestorm deals 250% damage and ignites enemies.
spell.resonant_arcana.world_pyre.sequenc: Five local meteor impacts; final area hit ×2.5.
spell.resonant_arcana.void_coronation.de: Flood the marked area with shadow and drifting void embers. Three expanding damage pulses suppress enemies with Darkness and Weakness II, followed by a double-damage collapse.
spell.resonant_arcana.heavens_thunder.de: Call six lightning columns around the mark, each striking a six-block area. A final fourteen-block thunderclap deals double damage. Columns can overlap.
spell.resonant_arcana.heavens_thunder.se: Six local lightning impacts; final area hit ×2.
spell.resonant_arcana.rift_collision.des: Pull visible enemies inward, then cut the area along two perpendicular lines. A final fourteen-block spatial implosion deals triple damage.
spell.resonant_arcana.rift_collision.seq: Two crossing cuts; final area hit ×3.
spell.resonant_arcana.soul_requiem.descr: Unleash three soul pulses at four, eight and twelve blocks from the mark. Enemies touched by a pulse are revealed and afflicted with Darkness. A final blast deals double damage across the area.
spell.resonant_arcana.soul_requiem.seque: Three expanding rings; final area hit ×2.
spell.resonant_arcana.worldroot_catastro: Overgrow the mark with moss, flowering leaves and spores. Three pulses damage, poison and slow enemies. A final bloom deals double damage and heals eligible allies.
spell.resonant_arcana.final_judgement.de: Summon a golden sword over the mark. Three holy pulses damage enemies and heal allies; the final verdict deals double damage, heals, cleanses afflictions and grants Resistance I for five seconds.
spell.resonant_arcana.eternal_winter.des: Unleash a ten-second blizzard over the marked area. Eight pulses damage and freeze enemies with Slowness IV. A final burst deals triple damage. Terrain remains intact.
spell.resonant_arcana.explosion.descript: Lock your aim and channel five golden seals into a towering ignition beam. Release one immense explosion; the rising fireball and shockwave deal no extra hits. Brief Slowness and Weakness follow the blast.
spell.resonant_arcana.explosion.sequence: One damage hit per enemy per cast.
spell.resonant_arcana.seraph_ascendant.d: Gain flight for twenty seconds; double-jump to fly. Nearby eligible allies gain 15% spell power and receive healing once per second. Slow Falling protects you when the blessing ends.
Channel cosmic energy, then release a sustained beam along your final aim. Each enemy entering its path takes one hit. New cover stops the beam.
One damage hit per enemy per cast.
spell.resonant_arcana.i_am_atomic.descri: Anchor a violet containment sphere and compress mana at a spectral sword. Hold enemies inside, shelter allies and absorb hostile projectiles crossing the boundary. Release one devastating detonation. Moving more than three blocks interrupts the ritual; bosses resist containment.
spell.resonant_arcana.i_am_atomic.sequen: One damage hit per enemy per cast.
spell.resonant_arcana.doom_beam.descript: Weave four open emerald focusing arcs, then unleash a rushing particle stream that follows your movement and aim. Each enemy entering its path takes one hit; solid cover stops it.
spell.resonant_arcana.doom_beam.sequence: One damage hit per enemy per cast.
spell.resonant_arcana.void_exile.descrip: Banish one hostile living target for ten seconds, leaving a violet rift. On return, it takes damage before receiving Weakness II for five seconds. Bosses, mounted, leashed and dimension-immune targets resist.
spell.resonant_arcana.void_domain.descri: Raise a vast black sphere at your casting location for fifteen seconds. Enemies inside suffer Slowness III, Weakness II and Darkness. You and eligible allies gain Resistance II, Regeneration II, Speed II and 25% spell power. Effects fade shortly after leaving; walls block their influence.
spell.resonant_arcana.polarity_bolt.desc: Fire a scarlet-and-azure magnetic bolt. Its first enemy impact deals damage and pulls the target toward you; solid cover stops it.
spell.resonant_arcana.emp_surge.descript: Release an electromagnetic pulse around yourself. Damage enemies, stun non-bosses for three seconds, interrupt eligible spellcasts and destroy hostile projectiles.
spell.resonant_arcana.magnetar_annihilat: Compress opposing magnetic poles, then unleash a blue-white annihilation beam following your aim for seven seconds. Each enemy entering it takes one heavy hit. Solid cover stops the beam.
Follows your aim; one damage hit per enemy.
spell.resonant_arcana.amber_talon.descri: Conjure a spectral Subterranodon that dives along your aim. Its first collision slashes one enemy and briefly lifts it; the spirit fades after the strike.
Awaken your allies’ dinosaur instincts for twenty seconds. Primal Instinct grants +25% melee damage, +20% attack speed and +15% movement speed, with Resistance I. The blessing does not stack with itself.
spell.resonant_arcana.lux_extinction.des: Condense a molten tephra sun over the mark. Four rounds of volcanic vents telegraph beneath up to six enemies; each erupts after 0.4 seconds and can be dodged. The core then falls in a double-damage extinction blast. Allies and terrain are protected.
spell.resonant_arcana.lux_extinction.seq: Four dodgeable vent rounds; final core impact ×2.
spell.resonant_arcana.acid_glob.descript: Lob a glowing acid glob along your aim. It splashes on the first enemy or solid surface, damaging enemies in a small area and poisoning them for three seconds.
spell.resonant_arcana.tremorzilla_breath: Channel Tremorzilla’s native atomic breath from your body for five seconds. Each enemy takes one hit. Hold Amber Curiosity offhand for purple retro breath, or a Tectonic Shard for orange; otherwise it is green. Cover stops the beam.
Follows your aim; one damage hit per enemy.
spell.resonant_arcana.nuclear_strike.des: Mark a nuclear strike. A descending warhead detonates after a visible warning, releasing one immense blast and Alex’s Caves mushroom cloud. Enemies are weakened by the fallout; allies and terrain remain protected.
spell.resonant_arcana.nuclear_strike.seq: Two-second warning; one blast per enemy.
spell.resonant_arcana.brine_bubble.descr: Launch a Deep One water bolt. Its first enemy impact deals damage and traps non-boss targets in Alex’s Caves bubble effect for two seconds.
Mark a breach in the ground. After a 1.2-second warning, a Hullbreaker rises from below, bites enemies in the marked circle and launches them upward before diving away. Solid cover and ally protection apply.
1.2-second warning; one breach hit per enemy.
spell.resonant_arcana.abyssal_deluge.des: Open a deep-sea vortex at the mark. Four tidal pulses drag enemies inward before a double-damage pressure collapse. Deep One magic and towering splashes trace the battlefield.
spell.resonant_arcana.desolate_dagger.de: Send a spectral Desolate Dagger along your aim. It pierces up to three enemies, dealing one hit and Weakness I to each before fading. Solid cover stops the blade.
spell.resonant_arcana.desolate_dagger.se: Pierces up to three enemies; one hit each.
spell.resonant_arcana.forsaken_sonar.des: Manifest the Forsaken’s jaws and release three aimed sonar waves. Each wave damages visible enemies in a broad forward cone, reveals them and briefly slows them.
Call forth a colossal Forsaken apparition. Three growing sonar shockwaves damage, reveal and darken enemies before a double-damage final roar.
spell.resonant_arcana.gumball_volley.des: Fire three native gumballs half a second apart. Each projectile bounces off one solid surface and damages the first enemy it reaches.
spell.resonant_arcana.gumball_volley.seq: Three projectiles; each can bounce once.
spell.resonant_arcana.frostmint_hex.desc: Place a sugar-staff hex surrounded by orbiting frostmint discs. Five pulses damage and freeze enemies inside; eligible allies gain Sugar Rush while holding the circle.
Raise a candy-witch vortex over the mark. Four peppermint storms batter enemies while a Gum Worm emerges below, then a double-damage candy burst ends the spell. Allies and terrain are protected.
spell.resonant_arcana.thunder_of_the_hea: Call a massive lightning storm over the mark. A dense storm canopy feeds repeated sky-to-ground bolts across the field. Allies and terrain are protected.
200 local lightning strikes; each has a 3-block radius.
spell.resonant_arcana.arcane_creation.de: Weave six rotating astral stars around the mark. Each star collapses in sequence, blasting a different sector, before the entire constellation converges into a double-damage central verdict.
spell.resonant_arcana.arcane_creation.se: Six sector impacts; final area hit ×2.
spell.resonant_arcana.crimson_apotheosis: Whip a storm of crimson petals and blood around the marked field. Repeated blood siphons wound enemies and restore a limited amount of the caster’s health. Allies and terrain are protected.
Five normal pulses; final area hit ×2.
spell.resonant_arcana.solar_supernova.de: Raise a giant square Minecraft sun over the mark. Its growing corona collapses into a devastating blast of fire that ignites enemies. Allies and terrain are protected.
spell.resonant_arcana.solar_supernova.se: One damage hit per enemy per cast.
spell.resonant_arcana.eventide_horizon.d: Open four crossing void seams through the mark. Successive rift cuts suppress enemies on those lines, then a final dimensional fold strikes the entire field for double damage. Each cut respects solid cover.
spell.resonant_arcana.eventide_horizon.s: Four crossing cuts; final area hit ×2.
spell.resonant_arcana.absolute_glaciatio: Bury the marked field in a thick snowstorm. Driving snow and frost repeatedly damage and freeze enemies before a final whiteout. Allies and terrain are protected.
Advancing front, four pulses; final shatter ×2.
Bloom a colossal five-petalled rafflesia from the ground. Its poisonous pollen draws in enemies while its living field heals and protects allies, ending with a powerful bloom pulse. Terrain is protected.
spell.resonant_arcana.heavens_covenant.d: Establish a radiant covenant. Five holy verdicts damage enemies and cleanse and heal eligible allies. Allies inside gain Resistance II and +35% spell power; leaving the field stops the refresh. A final double-damage verdict closes the covenant.
spell.resonant_arcana.heavens_covenant.s: Five normal pulses; final area hit ×2.
spell.resonant_arcana.soul_ascendancy.de: Raise five spiralling soul harvests over the mark. Each harvest reaps visible enemies and grants you a non-stacking absorption ward. The last procession closes in a double-damage soul burst. Walls and allies are protected.
spell.resonant_arcana.soul_ascendancy.se: Five normal pulses; final area hit ×2.
spell.resonant_arcana.planetary_polarity: Lift debris with a vast native magnetic field, pull enemies toward the mark, then drag a giant moon down from above. The moon impact delivers the spell’s crushing damage. Allies and terrain are protected.
Magnetic pull, then one falling-moon impact ×8.
spell.resonant_arcana.primordial_soverei: Raise a basalt volcano and unleash Luxtructosaurus-inspired eruptions of native tephra and magma. Five eruptions and a final blast damage enemies while Primal Instinct strengthens allies. Allies and terrain are protected.
Five normal pulses; final area hit ×2.
spell.resonant_arcana.tremorzilla_catacl: Gather purple atomic energy between your hands, then sweep a devastating Tremorzilla beam along your aim. No giant head obstructs the view. Solid cover stops it; allies and terrain are protected.
One damage hit per enemy per cast.
spell.resonant_arcana.abyssal_world_tide: Send four giant native ocean waves into the marked field. Churning water and foam pull enemies inward through repeated surges while allies gain water breathing and protection. Terrain is protected.
spell.resonant_arcana.forsaken_eclipse.d: Draw a giant sun and moon toward one another over the mark. Their collision unleashes a devastating eclipse blast that blinds and weakens enemies. Allies and terrain are protected.
spell.resonant_arcana.forsaken_eclipse.s: Sun and moon collide: one hit ×6, six seconds of Blindness and eight seconds of Darkness.
spell.resonant_arcana.confection_apocaly: Rain native Alex’s Caves gumballs, peppermint and candy fragments across the mark. Candy bombardments culminate in a huge confection burst and grant Sugar Rush to allies. Terrain is protected.
Six native gumball impacts; final candy burst ×3.
spell.resonant_arcana.kraken_world_drown: Summon eight invulnerable native Kraken tentacles together, all facing inward. Their synchronized slams pull enemies into a crushing undertow and deal drowning damage. Allies and terrain are protected.
Eight simultaneous inward tentacles; four drowning slams ×2 with a central undertow.
spell.resonant_arcana.yeti_world_heart.d: Summon a giant native Yeti avatar to pound the marked ground. Its slams send thick snow, native ice and freezing shockwaves through enemies. The avatar is invulnerable; allies and terrain are protected.
spell.resonant_arcana.yeti_world_heart.s: Four native Yeti slams: three hits ×1.33, final hit ×2; freezing and Slowness IV.
spell.resonant_arcana.helvar_final_edict: Manifest Helvar’s colossal sword over the mark. Blue and violet soul fractures warn its descent before the blade lands in a devastating spectral shockwave and rising soul-fire eruption. Allies and terrain are protected.
Three fracture waves; final sword hit ×3.
spell.resonant_arcana.sandworm_world_dev: Raise an invulnerable giant native sandworm at the centre of the mark. Four expanding sand shockwaves strike enemies as the worm shakes the ground. Allies and terrain are protected.
Invincible native sandworm; four expanding sand shockwaves: three hits ×1.5, final hit ×2.
spell.resonant_arcana.dragon_primordial_: Gather draconic fire with fire resistance, then release a huge aimed fire blast ending in a devastating fiery impact. No wings or temporary flight. Allies and terrain are protected.
Native dragon wings grant flight; one aimed cone and impact hit ×8 per enemy.
spell.resonant_arcana.orbital_ray.descri: Gather violet magic into a compact orb for 15 seconds. Send it skyward over four seconds, then lower a purple beam through sculk-blue and amethyst sparks for three seconds before a nuclear-style explosion. Each enemy takes one hit; allies and terrain are protected. Requires visible ground and at least 12 blocks of clear sky above the mark.
spell.resonant_arcana.orbital_ray.sequen: One damage hit per enemy per cast.
spell.resonant_arcana.angel_scream.descr: Unleash a holy scream as a travelling golden shockwave. The wave reaches twelve blocks in roughly 0.7 seconds. Each enemy it reaches in the 120-degree forward cone is held for three seconds and receives Weakness II for five seconds at level I. Walls and allies are respected.
spell.resonant_arcana.angel_scream.seque: Travelling 120-degree shockwave; three-second hold and five-second Weakness II on arrival at level I.
spell.resonant_arcana.arcane_hand.descri: Draw up to 32 nearby loose drops toward you for four seconds. Pickup delays, pickup ownership and walls are respected; inventories are never accessed.
spell.resonant_arcana.spell_prism.descri: Raise two floating prisms. Your next supported, caster-owned projectile bends through both toward the enemy marked at release. It redirects once without increasing its damage.
spell.resonant_arcana.blood_price.descri: Donate up to four health to shield one visible aimed ally for six seconds. The shield is 150% of donated health at level I and scales with spell power. The donation cannot kill you; shields refresh rather than stack.
spell.resonant_arcana.cinder_fuse.descri: Mark up to three nearby enemies with a burning fuse. After a two-second warning, each still-visible mark detonates once around itself. Breaking the visible connection or leaving range severs that mark.
spell.resonant_arcana.folded_passage.des: Open two filled violet gateways between your position and visible supported ground. Step into either gateway to cross; leave its arrival area before entering again. Each traveller has a two-second passage cooldown. Exits are rechecked for hazards, permissions and clearance on every crossing.
spell.resonant_arcana.orbit_exchange.des: Mark an aimed enemy and its nearest eligible neighbor. After a one-second warning exchange their supported positions if both destinations and the connecting path remain safe. Bosses, mounted and leashed entities resist.
spell.resonant_arcana.storm_rail.descrip: Lay an electrified route to a clear position. Each visible enemy crossing the rail receives one shock. Recast within eight seconds to dash safely to its end for no extra mana; new cover blocks the dash.
spell.resonant_arcana.echo_decoy.descrip: Create a translucent echo of your own appearance with luminous sculk ribs and sonar ripples. Ordinary visible hostile mobs attack it instead of allies. It stores up to 48 incoming hostile damage, then bursts in a sonic echo for its base damage plus half the stored damage. Bosses retain their targeting.
Gather up to eight temporary souls from your nearby combat kills for twelve seconds. Recast to send staggered soul strikes at a marked enemy, or sneak-recast to heal injured allies instead. Each soul is spent once; no permanent mobs are summoned.
spell.resonant_arcana.mycelial_relay.des: Grow two linked mushroom nodes for ten seconds. Half of effective healing received by an ally near either node can heal allies at the other. At most twelve health is relayed per cast at level I; relayed healing cannot repeat itself.
spell.resonant_arcana.martyrs_aegis.desc: Guard one visible aimed ally for five seconds. Intercept 35% of eligible incoming damage, up to twenty health across the cast at level I. Transferred damage cannot kill you, and intercepted damage cannot trigger another aegis.
spell.resonant_arcana.mirror_ice.descrip: Raise a directional ice mirror for eight seconds. Capture up to four supported hostile projectiles approaching its front. Recast to release them along your aim for no extra mana. Captured shots expire with the mirror and cannot become free ammunition.
spell.resonant_arcana.lodestone_snare.de: Raise red and blue magnetic pylons around an eight-block trap. Their arcing field drags enemies toward the centre, applies Slowness IV and discharges 5 base damage per second for eight seconds. Bosses resist the pull. Walls block the field.
spell.resonant_arcana.amber_stasis.descr: Encapsulate yourself in amber for two seconds. Eligible incoming damage is blocked while movement and Iron’s casting are suppressed. On release, push visible nearby enemies away. Void and other invulnerability-bypassing damage are not blocked.
spell.resonant_arcana.fallout_bloom.desc: Cleanse up to eight Poison or Wither afflictions from nearby eligible allies. After a one-second warning release a radioactive bloom, adding four base damage per affliction removed. The burst damages only visible enemies and preserves terrain.
spell.resonant_arcana.pressure_bell.desc: Raise a pressure dome for ten seconds. Allies receive Resistance II, Water Breathing and replenished air. The shell absorbs up to twelve hostile projectiles, storing 2 base collapse damage per shot. It repels ordinary enemies and slows intruders. Recast or wait for expiry to collapse it for 36–60 base damage and an outward pressure wave.
spell.resonant_arcana.stolen_shadow.desc: Rip a visible enemy's shadow into a dark humanoid double. The victim suffers Weakness and Slowness II. Its next damaging attack on an ally triggers a delayed shadow slash for 12 plus 75% of the attack damage, up to 30 base damage; bosses take half. If it refuses to attack, the shadow lashes for 16 base damage after three seconds. Triggers once.
spell.resonant_arcana.caramel_catapult.d: Unroll a caramel launch pad for eight seconds. Allies on the pad wind up for 0.4 seconds, then launch high along your original horizontal aim with six seconds of Slow Falling. Head clearance is checked before launch. Each ally launches once per pad; enemies crossing it suffer Slowness IV.
spell.resonant_arcana.oathbreaker_chains: Anchor a compact spectral Helvar sword and bind up to three visible enemies with ember chains. Allied melee strikes against the anchor transmit 75% of their damage, up to 20 base damage per target per strike and a 60-health total budget. Each attacker can trigger once per half second.
spell.resonant_arcana.whiteout_hunt.desc: Summon a sweeping eight-second hunting blizzard. Allies in the storm gain Speed II and Resistance I. Visible enemies suffer Slowness III, glow through the snow and take 4 base frost damage every 1.5 seconds. Ordinary mobs lose locks on sheltered allies; bosses retain their targeting.
spell.resonant_arcana.rho_aias.descripti: Instantly unfold a giant purple flower and three violet shield discs. Fully negates covered frontal attacks while draining 20 mana per second. Movement or depleted mana cancels it; no cooldown.
spell.resonant_arcana.rho_aias.sequence: Giant flower → three forward shield discs. Instant activation; no cooldown or damage capacity.
resonant_arcana.tooltip.rho_aias_allies: Ally protection: within %s blocks, behind the barrier
resonant_arcana.tooltip.rho_aias_sustain: Complete frontal negation • %s mana/second • Movement cancels
subtitles.resonant_arcana.thunder_of_the: Thunder of the Heavens gathers power
subtitles.resonant_arcana.choir_of_the_l: Choir of the Lost gathers power
Gather a colossal echo charge above the marked ground, then drive a massive sonic boom straight down. The impact deals heavy sonic damage and deafens enemies, slowing their movement and attacks. Allies and terrain are protected.
Descending sonic impact ×1.5; eight seconds of Deafened: muffled hearing, −25% movement and −30% attack speed.
spell.resonant_arcana.planet_befall.desc: Zhongli-inspired Geo burst. A colossal amber meteor falls onto the marked ground, dealing one heavy area hit and Petrifying enemies for four seconds. Petrified enemies cannot move, attack or cast. Terrain remains intact.
spell.resonant_arcana.preserver_of_fortu: Qiqi-inspired Cryo burst. Release a frost seal, heal nearby allies for eight health and mark enemies with Fortune Talismans for 15 seconds. Allied direct hits on marked enemies heal the attacker for four health, at most once per second per attacker.
spell.resonant_arcana.musou_shinsetsu.de: Raiden-inspired Electro burst. Unleash a wide violet sword slash for double damage, then four lightning cuts over seven seconds. Each cut hits once per enemy, respects cover and follows the direction you faced on release.
spell.resonant_arcana.winds_grand_ode.de: Venti-inspired Anemo burst. Open an eight-second emerald storm eye. Eight wind pulses damage visible enemies while an undertow draws ordinary enemies into the vortex. Bosses take damage without being displaced.
spell.resonant_arcana.celestial_shower.d: Ganyu-inspired Cryo burst. Suspend an ice pearl over the marked ground for 12 seconds. Twelve targeted icicles strike visible enemies inside the field, bursting in a three-block area and applying Slowness. Each enemy can be hit once per volley.
